extracted.intended_audience: Australian public, ABC audiences, stakeholders and those seeking information about the ABC's role and values
extracted.subtask_description: An organisational 'About Us' page describing the Australian Broadcasting Corporation's mission, editorial values, governance framework and public service remit. It communicates principles the ABC uses to produce and govern news, information and content for Australians.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide trusted news and information
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide trusted news and information to help Australians navigate contemporary life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framing the ABC's core purpose: delivering trustworthy journalism and information to support public understanding and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commission and celebrate Australian content
rubrics_metrics.description: As the leading commissioner of Australian content, we celebrate the richness of Australia's multicultural society and contribute to a sense of shared identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritise Australian stories, cultures and creative work that reflect national diversity and foster a shared cultural identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure access to fair and balanced news for all Australians
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring that all Australians have access to fair and balanced news and information wherever they live, and can see their stories, ideas, creativity and cultures reflected back to them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content and distribution should be inclusive and geographically accessible so audiences across Australia can access balanced coverage and representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal to diverse ages and interests across platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide news, information and entertainment that appeals to different ages and interests, and is freely available on all platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce a range of formats and genres to serve varied demographic and interest groups; ensure free availability across platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain independence, integrity, reliability and transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: To strengthen the trust and respect our audiences place in the ABC, we always maintain our independence, integrity and reliability, and strive for transparency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial decisions should protect independence from undue influence, adhere to integrity and reliability standards, and be as transparent as feasible; see referenced Editorial Policies, Corporate Responsibility and Freedom of Information resources for operational detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance creative performance with statutory obligations (corporate governance)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ABC Board and management apply a corporate governance framework that aims to balance the ABC’s performance as a creative media organisation, on the one hand, and its need to comply with the formal obligations of a statutory corporation on the other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Governance and management should reconcile creative/operational objectives with legal and statutory responsibilities; oversight structures (Board, Ombudsman, Advisory Council) support this balance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Celebrate and support local communities and international presence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content strategy should include focus on local community stories and maintain an international presence when relevant to audience interests and national remit.
